name: A Familiar Story
source:
A "familiar" is a magic animal companion, such as a witch's black cat. Familiars are used to boost the magic strength of their companions and have a history of being valuable allies. 

Follow the adventure and friendship between two lonely young heroes. Recruit allies and meet people and creatures along the way toward the boss battle.

This game was programmed in 48 hours for the Ludum Dare miniLD #27 on June 25-26, 2011.

[From [url=http://mcfunkypants.com/miniLD27/]McFunkypants[/url]]
translation:
“使魔”是一种魔法动物伙伴，例如魔女的黑猫。使魔能够增强同伴的魔力，历来都是宝贵的盟友。

跟随两位孤独的年轻英雄，见证他们的冒险与友谊。招募盟友，在前往首领战的旅途中结识各种人物与生物。

本作于2011年6月25日至26日，在48小时内完成编程，参加了Ludum Dare的miniLD #27活动。

［摘自[url=http://mcfunkypants.com/miniLD27/]McFunkypants[/url]］
